name: Zhejiang Galaxis Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Galaxis Technology Group Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures intralogistics robotics in global markets. The company offers products, such as Multi-directional Shuttle Robots (MSR), Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR), and Conveyor and Sorting Robots (CSR). Additionally, it develops software system, such as Warehouse Management System, Warehouse Control System, and Robot Control System. The company serves industries, including E-commerce, Pharmaceutical, Retail, Electronics, Automotive, Lithium Battery, Manufacturing, and Library. Zhejiang Galaxis Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2016 and is based in Jiaxing, China.
